new.text: 7.2.4.11.10 Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyTxData [SWS_Rte_05322] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTx Data_<CGI> ⌈ Service Name Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> Syntax BufReq_ReturnType Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> ( CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId, const PduInfoType* info, const RetryInfoType* retry, PduLengthType* availableDataPtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x0109 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant ComUserCbkHandleId Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API info Provides the destination buffer (SduDataPtr) and the number of bytes to be copied (SduLength). If not enough transmit data is available, no data is copied by the upper layer module and BUFREQ_E_BUSY is returned. The lower layer module may retry the call. An SduLength of 0 can be used to indicate state changes in the retry parameter or to query the current amount of available data in the upper layer module. In this case, the Sdu DataPtr may be a NULL_PTR. Parameters (in) retry Will not be handled by the RTE Implementation Plug-In. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) availableDataPtr Indicates the remaining number of bytes that are available in the upper layer module’s Tx buffer. availableDataPtr can be used by TP modules that support dynamic payload lengths (e.g. FrIsoTp) to determine the size of the following CFs. Return value BufReq_ReturnType BUFREQ_OK: Data has been copied to the transmit buffer completely as requested. BUFREQ_E_BUSY: Request could not be fulfilled, because the required amount of Tx data is not available. The lower layer module may retry this call later on. No data has been copied. BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK: Data has not been copied. Request failed. Description Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyTxData requests the transmit data for an I-PDU segment from the RTE Implementation Plug-In for the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph requiring transformation. This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom TP Rte_LdCom CbkCopyTxData callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_00693] for more details on the functionality of this callback. Available via Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05323] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317 ⌈The associated Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an ComIPdu which has its ComIPdu- Type parameter set to TP [SWS_COM_00917]. ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05324] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> Services from the Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPduDirec- tion parameter set to COM_SEND [SWS_COM_00917] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05325] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_ Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> call: • info • retry The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback.⌋ [SWS_Rte_05326] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall pass through the following OUT parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_ Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> call: • availableDataPtr ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05327] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> call is returned unchanged from the Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback. ⌋
